LanguageData.WotF_Ritual_InspectGathering: Gathering on the circle: the chant begins once every participant is on a chalk cell.
LanguageData.WotF_Ritual_InspectChanting: Chanting: the mana and offerings are taken only when the chant completes.

LanguageData.WotF_Ritual_HostFirst: Choose the host first to see the spells in their spellbook.
LanguageData.WotF_Ritual_HostNoBook: The host wears no awakened spellbook, so no page can be taken.
LanguageData.WotF_Ritual_EquipmentForm: That spell's form cannot go into equipment: only touch, self and orbit can.
